Class AbandonedStation

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.AbandonedStation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AbandonedStation extends Card
Represents the "Abandoned Station" encounter card.

Each eligible in-flight player in turn may choose to send a fixed number of crew members and spend days in order to load up specified goods. Upon supplying crew and correctly managing their cargo holds, the player delays their flight and the event ends.

    • nextPlayer

      public void nextPlayer()
      Advances to the next in-flight player who meets the crew requirement. Skips disconnected players and those with insufficient crew. Ends the event if all players have been considered.

      public void playerDisconnected(String playerName)
      Handles a player disconnecting mid-event by rewinding the index so that the nextPlayer logic will correctly advance. If the player already removed the crew to accept the goods gain and only needs to place them, the goods will be automatically placed randomly in the free spaces.

      playerDisconnected in class Card
      Parameters:
